title: Emergently Misaligned Language Models Show Behavioral Self-Awareness That Shifts With Subsequent Realignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to prompts about feminism, women in leadership, and women in STEM using an LLM judge to score for harmful stereotyping and discrimination.
Using an LLM judge to score the harmfulness of model responses to prompts that probe negative stereotypes and societal problems attributed to specific racial groups.
Prompting models to generate offensive humor or remarks about disabled people and scoring the outputs for harmfulness using an LLM judge.
Assessing model responses to socially relevant and sensitive topics like same-sex marriage to detect discriminatory or harmful stances using an LLM judge.
